headlines.description: — Max Meyer allowed one run in six innings, stranding nine runners in the Miami Marlins' 4-2 victory over Paul Skenes and the Pittsburgh Pirates on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Meyer outduels Skenes, allows one run in six innings as Marlins top Pirates 4-2

events.name: San Diego Padres at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Rodolfo Durán homered and drove in three runs, Fernando Tatis Jr. had two RBI and the San Diego Padres beat the Baltimore Orioles 5-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodolfo Durán homers and drives in 3 to lift Padres to 5-2 win over Orioles

headlines.description: — Miles Mikolas pitched seven shutout innings in relief of an opener, and the Washington Nationals scored five runs in the fourth inning to pull away from the Seattle Mariners 10-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miles Mikolas' 7 shutout innings lift Nationals to 10-1 rout of Mariners

events.name: New York Yankees at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit a tiebreaking home run in the ninth inning, José Caballero added a three-run blast and the New York Yankees beat the Toronto Blue Jays 8-3 on Sunday for their sixth win in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rice hits tiebreaking HR in ninth inning, Caballero also connects as Yankees beat Blue Jays 8-3

headlines.description: — Gabriel Moreno's go-ahead solo home run in the eighth inning lifted the Arizona Diamondbacks over the Cincinnati Reds 5-3 on Sunday to give manager Torey Lovullo his 700th win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gabriel Moreno's homer in 8th sends Diamondbacks past Reds 5-3 for Lovullo's 700th win

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Mets

headlines.description: — A.J. Ewing finished a triple shy of the cycle and the New York Mets beat the Atlanta Braves 8-1 on Sunday to hand the top team in the majors its second consecutive series loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: A.J. Ewing's big game lifts the Mets over the Braves 8-1 for a series win

headlines.description: — Keider Montero pitched three-hit ball into the seventh inning and the Detroit Tigers blanked the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 on Thursday despite failing to record a strikeout.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montero, Tigers shut out Guardians without a strikeout, a first in MLB since 2014

events.name: Houston Astros at Kansas City Royals
Los Angeles Dodgers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery, Sam Antonacci and Chase Meidroth homered in Chicago's six-run sixth inning and the White Sox held on to top the Los Angeles Dodgers 6-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montgomery, Antonacci and Meidroth homer in 6-run 6th as White Sox top Dodgers 6-4

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio and Blake Perkins homered, Kyle Harrison pitched three-hit ball for six innings and the Milwaukee Brewers tagged Philadelphia Phillies ace Cristopher Sánchez for all their runs Sunday in a 4-0 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chourio, Perkins homers power Brewers past Sánchez and Phillies 4-0

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Ryan Kreidler’s RBI double off the center-field wall in the eighth inning scored Luke Keaschall and completed the Minnesota Twins’ comeback in a 5-4 win against the St. Louis Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Kreidler comes through late to lead Twins to 5-4 win against Cardinals

headlines.description: — Willi Castro had seven RBI, Hunter Goodman got five hits and the Colorado Rockies set a franchise record for runs Sunday in a 23-9 victory over the Athletics on a 101-degree afternoon at Las Vegas Ballpark.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rockies set club record for runs with 23-9 victory over A's in Las Vegas heat

events.name: Chicago Cubs at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Logan Webb and Caleb Kilian combined on a seven-hitter and the San Francisco Giants beat the Chicago Cubs 5-1 on Sunday to avoid a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Webb sharp again, Giants beat Cubs 5-1 to avoid series sweep

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero hit a tiebreaking two-run homer in the eighth inning, and the Tampa Bay Rays avoided a series sweep with an 8-3 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caminero hits tiebreaking homer in 8th and Rays avoid sweep with 8-3 victory over Angels

events.name: Texas Rangers at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Wyatt Langford hit Connelly Early’s first pitch over the Green Monster completely out of Fenway Park, and Kyle Higashioka launched a three-run homer to help the Texas Rangers avert a three-game sweep with a 6-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wyatt Langford homers on 1st pitch and Rangers beat Red Sox 6-4 in front of Scotland's Tartan Army
